referee_caveats_inferred: No uncertainties are given on the line shifts, VMRs, altitude or temperature range, and no detection significance or rms is quoted.
Eastern line shift is given as -9.2 km/s in one place and fixed at -9.26 km/s in the fit.
Disk flux filtering by the interferometer is not shown to be included in the forward model, so the retrieved VMR and profile may be biased.
The temperature profile is a 1984 disk-averaged one, not limb-specific, and the retrieved 'temperature of HCN' is just the assumed atmospheric profile.
Only 476 s on source and a single HCN line, so the vertical profile is weakly constrained and the 475 km extent may reflect priors.
The formation-pathway claim rests on a qualitative Saturn versus Jupiter abundance comparison, not on chemical modelling.
The ozone line removal at 355.01 GHz sits close to the HCN window and its effect on the HCN baseline is not discussed.
